name: devknobs
author: Mert Duzgun
description: drop-in dev panel for emulating browser preferences, locale, geolocation and layout knobs from inside the page

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --format esm && bun build src/react.tsx --outdir dist --format esm --external react --banner '"use client";' && bun build src/global.ts --outfile dist/index.global.js --format iife --minify && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --project tsconfig.build.json
